name: What is the process for a multi-room remodel with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a multi-room remodel with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our multi-room remodeling process begins with a consultation to discuss your vision and needs. We then move to design and planning, including material selection and creating detailed blueprints. Once approved, we handle permits and begin construction. Throughout the project, we maintain open communication and conduct regular site visits to ensure quality and adherence to the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, design, planning, permits, and construction, with ongoing communication and quality checks.
